DESCRIPTION:
Objective: A user without Access Management permission sees no User & Access navigation.
Preconditions: Kesef CRM QA; USER_MANAGEMENT_VIEWER_* names an active account with no Access Management permission; USER_MANAGEMENT_MANAGER_* names a dedicated non-admin account the suite may disable and re-enable. Without them the test fails as BLOCKED.
Steps:
1. Sign in as the restricted account.
2. Read the navigation.
Expected: No User Management, Roles, Permission Sets or Teams link.
NAME: A user without Access Management permission sees no User & Access navigation
